tidal_oscillation.verdict: PASS on the documented per-model path

withdrawn_interpretation: The initial comparison looked only at the global and stratified WorldPlugin outputs. Those remain unchanged by design because tide is applied downstream by OceanCurrentModelPlugin per model; that comparison cannot diagnose the tidal feature.
limitations: Synthetic Docker controls with deliberately extreme harmonic constituents.
Functional data-path validation, not tidal-constituent or real-ocean accuracy.
The Gauss-Markov run validates variation and bounded liveness, not a full stochastic-process goodness-of-fit test.
The tidal run compares one static depth, one no-tide control and one tide-enabled model for 200 messages each.
